title: 헌법연구관 등의 근무성적평정 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Methods of Appraisal)
(1) Appraisers shall conduct appraisals objectively to ensure reliability and fairness.
(2) An appraiser may hear the opinions of a Justice of the Constitutional Court or a Constitution Research Officer who does not participate in the appraisal of the person concerned and reflect such opinions in the appraisal.
(3) Where a person subject to appraisal is seconded to another state agency, the appraiser may hear the opinion of the head of that agency and reflect it in the appraisal.
